The PERFECT High Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
candidates.description:
How to Perform the PERFECT High Cable Overhead Triceps Extension 
1️⃣ Set the cable high with the bar attachment (rope also works too).
2️⃣ Grab the bar with a thumbless grip—this allows for better elbow positioning compared to a full grip.
3️⃣ Face away from the machine 
4️⃣ Rest one glute (not the crack!) against the machine's pole for added stability. This helps maximize triceps engagement. You can skip this, but it will be less stable.
5️⃣ Step back into a staggered stance for a solid base and better balance.
6️⃣ Lean forward slightly (80-100 degrees) depending on what feels stable. Heavier weights may require more forward lean.
7️⃣ Tuck your elbows in to isolate the triceps and reduce strain on the elbows.
This setup ensures maximum tension on the triceps. 💪🔥

candidates.title: Cable Triceps Extension Key Points
candidates.description:
Cable Triceps Extension Key Points
✅ Wrist Position: Keep your wrists neutral or slightly externally rotated to make the downward movement more comfortable and reduce wrist strain.
✅ Depress Your Shoulders, Don’t Shrug: Keep your shoulders down to prevent compensation from the trapezius muscles, allowing your triceps to engage more effectively.
✅ Stable Elbows: Keep your elbows close to your body but not excessively tucked in, maintaining a natural movement path for smoother execution.
✅ Fixed Upper Arms with a Slight Forward Lean: Keep your upper arms close to your body and stable, while slightly leaning forward to increase the range of motion and maintain core stability.

candidates.title: ✅ The PERFECT Overhead DB Tricep Extension
candidates.description:
✅ The PERFECT Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension

1️⃣ Adjust Your Seat Position – Slide your butt slightly forward on the shoulder press seat so your torso leans back. This sets you up for better arm positioning in the next step.

2️⃣ Angle Your Upper Arms Slightly Back – Instead of keeping them completely vertical, let your upper arms tilt slightly backward. This adjustment keeps constant tension on your triceps and increases the effective range of motion, allowing you to lower the dumbbell further.

3️⃣ Tuck Your Elbows – Keep your elbows close to your head rather than flaring them out. This maintains tension on the triceps and reduces unnecessary strain on your elbows.

4️⃣ Maximize Your Range of Motion – Lower the dumbbell as far as your mobility allows to fully stretch your triceps for more gains.

candidates.title: MACHINE TRICEP EXTENSION (How To)
candidates.description:
TARGET MUSCLE: Triceps
SYNERGISTS (SUPPORTING MUSCLES): None
MECHANICS: Isolation Movement
FORCE: Push

EXECUTION

- With your upper arm flat on the arm pad, exhale as you push the handles down until your elbows are fully extended.
- Inhale as you reverse the motion in a controlled motion, until you feel a mild stretch in your triceps

TIPS

- Make sure your upper arm remains in contact with the arm pad throughout the set, if not you could adjust the seat.
- Do not allow your elbows to flare out during the set, keep your hands and elbows inline with the shoulders..
- This is a great machine to safely and effectively isolate and build your triceps
